correctness.rationale: For fixed a>b>0, u!=v, h>0, the two proximal compositions have common contraction r=1/((1+ha)(1+hb)), independent offsets differing by Delta=h^2ab(u-v)/((1+ha)(1+hb)). The stationary mean displacement from the original quadratic average minimizer is Delta(p-a/(a+b))/(1-r), and variance Delta^2p(1-p)/(1-r^2). Their sum gives equation (1). The second derivative of the bracket is 4r/((1-r)^2(1+r))>0, yielding the clipped unique p*(h), boundary (1+ha)(1+hb)=(a+3b)/(a-b), and exact small-h leading coefficients. At u=v the stated nonzero-gap uniqueness fails, but u!=v is explicitly assumed; h>0 keeps r in (0,1). The provided exact-rational verify.py was inspected, not accepted merely from its 15,624-assertion report.
